description: Shopify CLI helps you build Shopify apps. It quickly generates Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and PHP apps, app extensions, Shopify Scripts (beta), and Shopify themes. You can also use it for Shopify themes and when automating many common development tasks. Visit https://shopify.dev/apps/tools/cli to know more
name: shopify

subcommands.description: Creates your app extension and associates it with an app in your Partner organization. This step should be done only once for each app extension. Before you can push your code to Shopify, you need to create an app in your Partner Dashboard that you want to register your extension to. After an extension is registered to an app, the registration can’t be undone
